name: beta-2-microglobulin

function.text: B2M encodes beta-2-microglobulin [Cleaved into: Beta-2-microglobulin form pI 5.3]. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and structural molecule activity. It participates in immune response and protein homotetramerization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hypoproteinemia, hypercatabolic (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
